title: Peter Jennings' UFO special cut by 90%, followed by his death

tellings.quote: they aired it but what they aired excluded 90% of the material.

plain: In 2005, a television special on UFOs presented by the ABC news anchor Peter Jennings went on air with most of its material cut out, according to a researcher named Jason Jorjani. He says "what they aired excluded 90% of the material," and the story as he tells it ends with Jennings's death soon after. If true, it would mean much of what the program found was held back from viewers.
